proof_attempt_summary: The occupied saturated-contact proposal was switched to atom- and support-robust randomized Lee envelope learning, yielding a total exactly honest empirical selector, an all-rule three-law converse, and the matched fixed-K rare-target rate min{1,(n gamma)^(-1/2)}. The final mathematics review passed and verified ten source leaves, but the novelty referee graded subfield at a 6.5 ceiling below the required 7.4 field floor, with no bounded in-scope lift; an independent main validity audit confirmed the downgraded disposition. Growing-K dependence, optimal constants, broader actions and selection-driven lower witnesses remain future work; Lean formalization was not attempted.
tldr: Lee strict positivity alone does not permit uniform oracle-relative length consistency under exact global marginal honesty: even with bounded treated outcomes, fixed finite cells and fair assignment, the bounded no-floor minimax excess has lower limit at least \(0.02862270708\). With a fixed public selected-control mass floor, the all-rule minimax order is \(n^{-1/2}\): an explicit three-law certificate matches the exponent of a total empirical selector with exact finite-sample ninety-percent marginal coverage. The randomized full-observed oracle has a primal-dual envelope that includes atoms and interior cutoffs. The optimal fixed-parameter constant and sharp dependence on growing cell count and decreasing floor remain open.
